nodes.text: Chandigarh PGIMER clarifies there is no surge in influenza-like cases or hospitalizations due to Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV). Follow good hygiene practices like handwashing & mask-wearing in crowded spaces. Medical facilities are equipped to handle respiratory illnesses. #HMPV
